name: tau2-scope-lessons-01

pairs.workflow: change of destination on an existing booking
change to a nonstop flight subject to the current fare
new booking with passenger and payment constraints
two cancellation decisions and one cabin upgrade

append_instruction: For each lesson, identify what it applies to. Distinguish facts from this past interaction from values or permissions that should be checked again for each relevant person, reservation, or action in a new case.
scope: Generate both versions of the lesson anew from exactly the same archived first-pass public conversations. Change only the appended writer instruction. Preserve the writer's option to save nothing. Use the same read-only preload for both conditions. No target scenario, reference answer, previous grade or analyst rubric reaches the writer. The simulator receives only its native target setup; the worker receives the native agent context and assigned delivery.
selection: Include one task per remaining test-only customer, taking the lowest numeric ID for a shared customer (6 rather than 45). These three reference outcomes require no state mutation or scored communication. Add two previously unused test IDs with reference writes: 8 for a new booking and 37 for mixed decisions across reservations. Both customers occur in train. Match each to a different train customer by workflow before any new response. The earlier design targets 18 and 26 and their sources 0 and 17 are excluded. Keep the two strata visible.
primary: Pair lesson_scoped vs lesson_original inside target, writer seed and solver seed. Count gains, losses, ties and unavailable comparisons separately in each stratum. Also report each writer arm vs matched no_memory and empty_preload, and empty_preload vs no_memory. Report every assignment including voluntarily empty writers, and any failed writer or unavailable grade.
secondary: Trace each first-pass source to actual writer prompt and voluntary saved title/body, actual worker exposure, current-customer questions, native lookup results, mutation arguments and official score. Report both seeds of each bank, per-target counts, and stage costs. Evidence for a mechanism is descriptive. The five customers are the independent case units; repeated solvers and shared controls are paired.

behavior_rubric.writing: Before unmasking outcomes, code each saved bank from title/body only. Unit: an explicit rule tied to a named level such as passenger, booking, segment, payment method or action. Recheck: an explicit direction to obtain a current fact or permission, naming that fact or permission. Both may occur in different items; retain verbatim support for each and record empty banks separately.
behavior_rubric.all: Record executed lookup of each nominated current reservation, exact mutation target and fields, failed or rejected business calls, any executed escalation, and all customer-facing information or confirmation requests with surrounding replies. Check affirmative approval of the stated action before the first executed state change; separate unsolicited customer details and generic offers. Record source-only customer, booking or payment IDs reused in worker speech and tools. Keep official score separate.
behavior_rubric.6: Look for the current booking, a customer-facing explanation that insurance cannot be added after booking, any new booking or change, and escalation despite the stated preference.
behavior_rubric.13: Check customer-facing explanation that the existing destination cannot be changed, and execution of the requested human handoff. An explanation only in the handoff tool does not count as telling the customer.
behavior_rubric.31: Check lookup of the matching JFK May 17 booking, explanation that the current basic-economy fare restricts changing flights, and any new booking or mutation.
behavior_rubric.8: Check lookup of the prior booking, final passenger list, single certificate and amount, and the exact reference booking. Check whether the customer explicitly approved the proposal before the first executed mutation.
behavior_rubric.37: Check each current booking lookup, the two distinct cancellation decisions, exact cabin change on the third booking and individual mutation fields including payment. Record authorization for the actual proposed change before a write.

failure_policy: No resubmission of started jobs. An incomplete writer leaves its assigned solver slots unstarted. In independent ledgers reserve received listed HTTP errors at their wire-specific maximum; any other unknown cost stops that ledger. Retain all missing denominators.
